interface.name: jwm_remote_keyboard_manager_v1
interface.description: This private protocol is not a desktop portal. A trusted local host must obtain explicit keyboard consent, select a source on this connection, and authenticate its remote peer. It cannot switch focus or authorize pointer or clipboard access.

interface.name: jwm_remote_keyboard_lease_v1
interface.description: A lease expires after 30 seconds and never revives. Each capture source permits exactly one keyboard attempt, including failed admission; a fresh explicit local source selection is required to attempt another lease. The host must compare the full viewer and native XKB maps, then arm using its first genuinely ready image-copy frame only after the authenticated viewer reports drawing it. The compositor cannot prove physical display. This gates a fixed surface geometry, not the latest visual content for every key.

arg.name: reason
arg.summary: 1 denied, 2 source, 3 focus or seat, 4 local takeover, 5 timeout, 6 malformed sequence, 7 quota
